The StreamYard API provides programmatic access to StreamYard's professional live streaming and recording studio. Manage broadcasts, destinations (YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitch, etc.), recordings, and guest invitations. StreamYard enables simultaneous multi-platform streaming with a browser-based studio. OAuth 2.0 is used for authentication.
